mapper.select: select A.*, B.USER_LOGIN_ID, B.USER_NM from JCMS_LOGIN_LOG A left join JCMS_USER B on A.USER_ID = B.USER_ID where 1=1 and A.USER_ID = #{user.userId} and B.USER_LOGIN_ID LIKE CONCAT('%', #{userLoginIdLike}, '%') and B.USER_NM LIKE CONCAT('%', #{userNmLike}, '%') and A.LOGIN_IP LIKE CONCAT('%', #{loginIpLike}, '%') order by ${sort} ${sortOrd} limit #{start}, #{length}

select COUNT(*) from JCMS_LOGIN_LOG A left join JCMS_USER B on A.USER_ID = B.USER_ID where 1=1 and A.USER_ID = #{user.userId} and B.USER_LOGIN_ID LIKE CONCAT('%', #{userLoginIdLike}, '%') and B.USER_NM LIKE CONCAT('%', #{userNmLike}, '%') and A.LOGIN_IP LIKE CONCAT('%', #{loginIpLike}, '%')
mapper.insert: insert into JCMS_LOGIN_LOG ( USER_ID, LOGIN_IP, LOGIN_DT ) values ( #{user.userId}, #{loginIp}, SYSDATE() )
mapper.update: update JCMS_LOGIN_LOG set LOGOUT_DT = NOW() where LOGIN_LOG_ID = #{loginLogId}
mapper.select:
select COUNT(USER_ID) as LOGIN_COUNT, DATE_FORMAT(LOGIN_DT,'%Y-%m-%d') AS SEARCH_DATE from JCMS_LOGIN_LOG where 1=1 and USER_ID = #{user.userId}
and LOGIN_DT >= STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(#{startSearchDt}, ' 00:00:00'), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s')
and LOGIN_DT <= STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(#{endSearchDt}, ' 23:59:59'), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s')
GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(LOGIN_DT,'%Y-%m-%d') order by DATE_FORMAT(LOGIN_DT,'%Y-%m-%d') DESC
